intro.title: In the Hall of the Mountain King
intro.text: Grieg, Peer Gynt, 1875. One tune, again and again, getting louder each time: start very soft (pp) and build to very loud (ff). B minor: F♯ and C♯ in the key signature, plus a few naturals.
